errors.expired: Signing in with Google has expired. Please try again.

account.title: Google
account.linked: The account is linked to Google. You can sign in with Google.
account.notLinked: The account is not linked to Google.

link.intro: Confirm your password to link. You will then be redirected to Google.

unlink.intro: After unlinking you will sign in with your password only.

noPassword.hint: Your account has no password yet (you sign in with Google). This action requires one.
noPassword.howTo: Set it under “Set password” within 10 minutes of signing in with Google, or through a link sent by e-mail.
noPassword.sendLink: Send a link to set a password
noPassword.sent: A link to set your password is on its way to your inbox.
noPassword.guest: The account has no password yet. Use Google, or set a password through “Forgot password”.

setPassword.title: Set password
setPassword.intro: The account has no password yet. Set one to be able to sign in without Google.
setPassword.expired: A password can be set this way only within 10 minutes of signing in with Google. Sign in with Google again, or use the e-mail link (“Forgot password”).
